about.title: Meshloom Remote
about.intro: Open this Meshloom from anywhere, without opening a port on your router. Only the devices you allow can get in.
about.secure: Protect access: use a passkey or turn on two-factor authentication.

status.title: Status
status.askAdmin: Only an administrator can turn Meshloom Remote on.

badgeHelp.off: Remote is off: nothing is sent to the relay.
badgeHelp.unregistered: The relay did not register this instance. Try again.
badgeHelp.connected: Your allowed devices open this instance at the address below.
badgeHelp.reconnecting: The link to the relay is down and Meshloom reconnects on its own. Check this machine's internet connection.
badgeHelp.not_registered: The relay no longer knows this instance. Turn Remote off and on again.
badgeHelp.paused: The relay paused this instance. Meshloom tries again on its own within 20 minutes.
badgeHelp.quota_exceeded: Remote is back on the 1st of next month. Meshloom keeps working on your local network.
badgeHelp.replaced: Another install uses this instance's key, often a restored backup. Replace the key here.
badgeHelp.banned: The relay banned this instance. Contact TwinRocket if this is a mistake.
badgeHelp.relay_paused: Meshloom Remote is paused for everyone. Meshloom tries again on its own.
badgeHelp.unknown: The relay reports a state this version does not know.
badgeHelp.needs_community: Remote needs Meshloom Community. Turn Community on first.
badgeHelp.community_off: Community is off, so Remote is paused. Your address and devices are kept.

enable.title: Turn on Meshloom Remote?
enable.help: This instance gets a meshloom.link address. You then allow each device.
enable.isolationWarning: Plugins run without a sandbox: protect every administrator with a passkey or two-factor authentication.
enable.isolationAck: I understand, turn it on anyway.

disable.title: Turn off Meshloom Remote?
disable.help: Your devices can no longer open the instance remotely. Their list is kept.

unregister.title: Leave Meshloom Remote?
unregister.help: The relay forgets this instance's address. Come back within 30 days to get it again.

rotate.title: Replace the Remote key?
rotate.help: The instance gets a new address, and every device must be allowed again.

enroll.title: Allow a device
enroll.help: Scan a QR code with the device to allow. Without a camera, send an access request instead.
enroll.lanOnly: The QR code only shows on the local network. From here, approve an access request instead.
enroll.dialogTitle: Scan with the device to allow
enroll.dialogHelp: Scan this QR code with the device, then sign in as usual.
enroll.secretWarning: Do not share this QR code: it opens access to your account.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code to allow a device with Meshloom Remote
enroll.expired: This code has expired, so the QR code is hidden.

requests.title: Access requests
requests.help: Type the code shown by the device asking for access.
requests.socialWarning: Only approve your own device, never a code someone passes on to you.
requests.label: Device name (optional)
requests.offline: The connection to the relay is down: approving is not possible right now.

devices.title: Allowed devices
devices.help: Revoke a device you lost or no longer use.
devices.helpAdmin: Devices of every account. Revoke a device that is lost or no longer used.
devices.revokeHelp: This device will no longer open the instance remotely.
devices.revokeAllHelp: Every device, of every account, loses remote access.
devices.notPushed: The relay is out of reach: this change applies once it reconnects.

alertEmail.title: Alert e-mail
alertEmail.help: Get an e-mail when this instance nears or reaches its monthly quota. Only the relay keeps the address.
alertEmail.label: E-mail address

state.pending: Open the link in the confirmation e-mail to turn on alerts.
state.confirmed: An address is confirmed. It is not shown here: type a new one to replace it.

domain.title: Your own domain
domain.help: Create a URL redirect from your domain to https://{{hostname}}, then test it here.
domain.label: Your domain

no_redirect.title: No redirect
no_redirect.help: Your domain answered HTTP {{status}} without a redirect. Create a redirect to https://{{hostname}}.

wrong_target.title: Wrong target
wrong_target.help: Your domain redirects to “{{target}}” instead of {{hostname}}. Fix the destination of the redirect.

invalid_domain.title: Not a domain name
invalid_domain.help: Type a name such as chat.example.org, without a port or path.

unreachable.title: Your domain could not be reached
unreachable.help: This instance could not get an answer from your domain.

reason.egress_unresolvable: The name does not resolve: check the DNS record of the domain.
reason.egress_private_address: The name points to a private or local address, which is never contacted.
reason.egress_scheme: The address is not a valid web address.
reason.timeout: The domain did not answer in time.
reason.tls_error: The secure connection failed: the certificate does not match the domain.
reason.connect_error: The connection was refused or lost.

securityNotice.remote_reduced_plugin_isolation: Remote is on and plugins run without a sandbox: protect every administrator with a passkey or two-factor authentication.

errors.remote_not_registered: This instance is not registered with Meshloom Remote.
errors.remote_unavailable: Meshloom Remote did not answer. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.
errors.remote_rate_limited: Too many requests to Meshloom Remote: try again later.
errors.remote_lan_only: The QR code to allow a device is shown on the local network only.
errors.remote_access_request_not_found: No request matches this code. Check the code shown on the device.
errors.remote_offline: The connection to the relay is down: try again once it is back.
errors.remote_pass_required: This device is not allowed with Meshloom Remote.
errors.remote_host_mismatch: This request is not for this instance's Remote address.
errors.remote_request_invalid: The relay sent an invalid request.
errors.remote_alert_email_invalid: This is not a valid e-mail address.
errors.remote_alert_email_frozen: This address cannot be changed for now.
errors.remote_alert_email_paused: Alert e-mails cannot be changed right now. Try again later.
errors.remote_community_off: Remote needs Meshloom Community. Turn Community on first.
errors.remote_radio_not_heard: No other station has heard this radio lately: send a flood advertisement, then try again.
errors.remote_community_opted_out: This radio has left Meshloom Community: join it again in the Community settings.
errors.remote_community_banned: Meshloom Community has blocked this radio; if this is a mistake, write to ban@meshloom.app.
errors.remote_attestation_unavailable: Meshloom Community cannot vouch for this radio right now. Try again later.
